comments.author: Ellistrae
comments.body: Reward from 2015 GAMA Halloween Event. Can produce: Castella x10, Xocolatl x10, Candy Assortment x10, Macaron x10, Special Bouchee x10, Fruit Cheese Cake x10 or Star Shaped Baked Confectionary x10. Will update if other items can be generated.

comments.author: Ellistrae
comments.body: Also generates Chiacchiere x10 & Bizcocho Sherbet x10.

wiki:
